content.text:
I fixed the one verified finding and honored the outstanding Field-of-the-Disclosure request.

**The finding — unsupported contact/clearance topology.** The description sentence that tied line 2-2 to places of contact and line 4-4 to a place of clearance is replaced with the wording the report prescribes, so the two views still show what they show (bearing contact in FIG. 2, the clearance in FIG. 4) without asserting that contact and clearance occupy distinct, separately sectionable regions around the loop. The FIG. 3 brief no longer plots each section line against a particular part of the ring; it keeps one horizontal and one vertical line — the antecedents its later arrow-and-numeral paragraphs depend on — and marks their positions as a placement convention, with the non-assertion made explicit. Nothing in the numeral table, claims, Brief Description or the FIG. 2 and FIG. 4 briefs needed to move: none of them assert the distribution the finding objected to.

**The Field.** Tightened only, meaning unchanged: the three-fold infinitive tail becomes a participial one and "moving autonomously" becomes "autonomously moving", matching the "autonomous movement" already used in the detailed description. Every other section is byte for byte as it was.

content.text:
Two changes, both minimal and confined to the named files.

**1. The verified finding (blocker).** The FIG. 3 brief's section-line disclaimer denied the very contact/clearance distribution that FIG. 2 (cut where the perimeter member bears, legs resting on the band, clearance appearing only in FIG. 4) and FIG. 4 (cut where the clearance is present) depict, and that `draft/07-drawings.md` recites. I removed only the overreaching clause, exactly as the report directs, and kept the accurate hedge that the drawn angular position is a placement convention. The FIG. 2 and FIG. 4 briefs, `draft/07-drawings.md`, the claims, the numeral table and the description are untouched — the partial-contact/partial-clearance condition is source-supported ("restricts airflow into the chamber while maintaining rigid contact with the tile"), so nothing in the application needed to move to make the briefs consistent. FIG. 3 will re-render from the amended brief through the drawing pipeline; no rendered artifact was edited.

**2. The pending user instruction.** The last conversation turn asks to tighten the Field of the Disclosure without changing its meaning, and it had not yet been actioned. I removed the "vibration device that vibrates" repetition and converted the trailing gerund chain to the purpose infinitive it already implied. No matter added or dropped: the hand-guided / pulled / autonomously moving triad, the bonding-material examples and the three effects all survive verbatim in substance. Every other section is byte for byte as it was.

No claim, numeral definition, description passage, embodiment, other figure brief or rendered sheet was altered.

The remaining hedge, that the drawn positions and angular crossing positions are a placement convention for this sheet only, is retained unchanged.

draft/04-field.md: tightened 'a vibration device that vibrates a covering element ... releasing trapped air, distributing that bonding material and improving its contact' to 'a vibration device for vibrating a covering element ... to release trapped air, distribute the bonding material and improve its contact', removing the vibration-device/vibrates repetition and the gerund chain. The hand-guided, pulled and autonomously moving alternatives, the thinset/mortar/adhesive examples and all three recited effects are unchanged.

No change made to the FIG. 2 brief, the FIG. 4 brief, draft/07-drawings.md, any claim, the numeral table, the detailed description or any disclosed embodiment; FIG. 3 re-renders from the amended brief through the drawing pipeline and no generated artifact was edited.
